effects.description: (2) Set Arms: Mortal Strike and Execute damage increased by 10% and when you Slam a target, Slam also deals (100% of Attack Power) damage to enemies within 8 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
(2) Set Fury: Raging Blow damage increased by 15%. During Recklessness Raging Blow extends the duration of Recklessness by 2 sec, up to 6 sec.
(2) Set Protection: Your free Revenges deal 15% additional damage and cause your next Shield Slam to deal 20% additional damage.
(4) Set Arms: Overpower damage increased by 15%. Mortal Strike and Overpower increase the damage of your next Slam by 20%, stacking up to 5 times. (500ms cooldown)
(4) Set Fury: Bloodthirst damage increased by 10%. During Recklessness Bloodthirst increases the critical strike bonus of Recklessness by 3%, up to 6%.
(4) Set Protection: Ravager and your free Revenges cause all targets to bleed for (304.745% of Attack Power) damage over 12 sec. Ravager's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
